# Method IsVirtualDocument

#### IsVirtualDocument(DocumentId)

Determines whether the document is virtual.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 17, 0, 0)]
bool IsVirtualDocument(DocumentId inDocumentId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document to analyse.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  Tells wether the document is virtual.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.17.
